verdict: PARTIAL — T1/T2/T4/T5 REAL, T3 PARTIAL (engines exist but zero trained weights), T6 PARTIAL (1 symbolic-projection engine, NO Z3/MIP/LP solver dependency), T7 MISSING-CRITICAL (PRISMCreativeReasoningEngine ships marketing JSDoc over a 10-row lookup table per Round-1 finding). Safety+Omega gates exist as runtime actions but spec's S(x)>=0.70 / Omega>=0.70 floors not bound to MS2 unit acceptance.

tier_verdicts.T3_lora: PARTIAL — engines/schemas/actions exist, training infrastructure exists, ZERO .safetensors checkpoints shipped (Round-1 F-r1)
tier_verdicts.T5_ai_router: REAL (1 engine, weekly digest cron missing per Round-1 F-r1)
tier_verdicts.T6_symbolic: PARTIAL — projection-based symbolic enforcer, NOT a solver. No z3-solver/lp_solve/glpk dependency in package.json. Spec promises Z3+MIP+LP for tolerance allocation + scheduling; only Kienzle/Taylor/RPM/feed lexicographic projection exists.

All three cases exist in aiReasoningDispatcher.ts: case 'ai_milling_deep_reason' line 897, case 'ai_wedm_deep_logic' line 907, case 'cot_reason_tree' line 1372. Dispatcher action enum + handlers wired.

findings.claim: aiSystemRouterEngine, federated learn, transfer scaling, prototypical regression
findings.evidence: AISystemRouterEngine.ts exists at mcp-server/src/engines/AISystemRouterEngine.ts. Test file AISystemRouterEngine.test.ts exists. Routed from devDispatcher, camDispatcher, edmDispatcher, intelligenceDispatcher, memoryDispatcher (5 dispatchers). Companion engines: CrossProcessTransferLearningEngine, CrossProcessMAMLLiteEngine, CrossProcessTierRouterEngine. Round-1 caveat: 'telemetry ledger has no consumer — write-only'.

findings.claim: Z3 / constraint solver / MIP — formal allocation (tolerance + scheduling + cost)
findings.evidence: CrossProcessSymbolicConstraintEnforcerEngine.ts exists, but its header documents it as a PROJECTION engine, not a solver: 'projects an arbitrary cutting-condition prediction onto the feasible region defined by physics-backed envelopes'. Strategy is 'lexicographic, safety-first' reduce-vc/reduce-fz — NOT a SAT/SMT/MIP/LP solver. No z3-solver, lp_solve, glpk, javascript-lp-solver, node-z3, smt, or coin-or dependency in mcp-server/package.json. No Z3*.ts, SMT*.ts, MIP*.ts, Symbolic*.ts files (only CrossProcessSymbolicConstraintEnforcerEngine). Spec's row-11 'Z3 x ToleranceStack: Min-cost t_i s.t. Σ ≤ T' and row-12 'MIP x Capacity x Bid: argmax Σ(margin·accept)' have NO solver to call.

intelligenceDispatcher.ts:549 declares graph_query, graph_infer, graph_discover, graph_predict, graph_traverse — action enum exists. PRISMCreativeReasoningEngine.ts file exists at mcp-server/src/engines/PRISMCreativeReasoningEngine.ts. Round-1 finding F-r1 (ai-reasoning domain) verbatim: 'PRISMCreativeReasoningEngine.explore() needs to be either (a) renamed to PRISMRuleBasedCombinatorEngine to match what it actually does, OR (b) routed through aiSystemRouterEngine.route("reasoning") to get a real LLM call. Current state ships a marketing-grade JSDoc over a 10-row lookup table.' Spec's MS2 rows 24/29/47/48/49/50 all invoke T7 KG/creative — they will receive a static lookup, not analogy reasoning.

findings.claim: Safety oracle (S(x) >= 0.70) blocks emission if score below floor
findings.evidence: validate_physics is REGISTERED in guardDispatcher.ts:127 as 'prism:prism_safety action=validate_physics' and bayes_safety_set_prior/get_prior/observe wired (line 31). safetyDispatcher.ts has NO matches for validate_physics/safety_oracle/S(x)/omega_gate (zero direct binding). Action surface exists; the 0.70 floor as a HARD GATE on MS2 unit acceptance is not enforced in any reviewed dispatcher case statement. Bayes-safety priors infrastructure shipped but threshold-binding to revenue-emission path unverified.

findings.claim: Omega (Ω >= 0.70) blocks emission if quality below floor (R, C, P, S, L)
findings.evidence: omegaDispatcher.ts exports omegaQuick(R,C,P,S,L) at line 38 + computeOmega() at line 45 (5-component score). omegaHistory ledger exists. Engine wires to SP, ATCS, RoadmapExecutor per JSDoc. HOWEVER spec's MS2-emission-gate (Ω>=0.70 as a HARD BLOCK before revenue emission) is not bound to any unit-acceptance hook in spec-referenced units U-INV-MILL-01..08 / U-INV-LATHE-01..07 / U-INV-WEDM-01..06.

Spec line 502: 'Every MS2 unit declares which tiers it invokes (e.g. tiers_invoked: [T1, T2, T4])'. Reviewed milestone envelope schema at mcp-server/data/milestones/* does not declare a tiers_invoked field. Atomic-roadmap-emit.mjs does not enforce/validate this field. The orchestration tier-balance pie chart on line 566 ('Tier-invocation pie chart for MS2 (T1..T7 distribution)') has no upstream data source.
